name: Shinsengumi Amazing ~Hoteru Karada to Koibonoo~
original_name: 新撰組アメイジング～火照る躰と恋炎～
source: The year is 1864, at the end of the Edo period. A group of men bravely took action to extinguish a burning house. Those men were part of a group called the Shinsengumi. In order to protect the city of Kyoto, they would rush to any place that needed them. The curtain rises on the crusade of the members of the Shinsengumi, whose hearts burn as passionately as a the flames they fight...
translation: 1864年，江户时代末期。一群男人勇敢行动，扑灭一栋着火的房屋。他们属于新选组。为了保护京都，他们会奔赴任何需要帮助的地方。新选组成员的征讨就此拉开帷幕，他们的心如同正在扑灭的火焰般炽热……
